title: “Free”
body: The first thing it said was for a subscription after I read a little about the app when it said free. If you don’t pay you can only do 2 things. Also when I was asked my name the youngest option was 18 when it says the youngest you can be on this app was 4.
author: Hiiiiiiiiiiiiiippl

title: Free lifetime scam
body: This is the second time I have downloaded this app when it said you could get a free lifetime subscription. Once again that’s not an option.  I am deleting this app for the second and final time.
author: TJ in MD
